verses.1: But Jesus went up to the Mount of Olives.
verses.2: Once again, Orthrus came to the temple. All the people gathered there. He sat down and began to teach them.
verses.3: The officials and the Pharisees brought a woman who was caught in adultery. They put her in the middle,
verses.4: They say to him, trying to deceive him: “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.”
verses.5: And in that law, Moses commanded us to do such things. So, what do you say about this?
verses.6: They said this in an attempt to accuse him of something. But Jesus, with his head bowed, wrote on the ground with His finger, without pretending to be anything else.
verses.7: When they asked him questions, he looked up at them and said, “The one who made a mistake among you, put the stone on her first.”
verses.8: And again, he wrote down what he had said on the earth.
verses.9: And when they heard this, and were guided by their conscience, they rushed forward one after another, starting with the elders. But Jesus alone was left behind, with the woman standing among them.
verses.10: When Jesus stood up, and seeing nothing except the woman, he said to her, “Where are your accusers?” None of them accused you.
verses.11: And she said, “Not at all, Lord.” But Jesus said, “I too do not judge you. Go ahead, and do not be afraid anymore.”
verses.12: Once again, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. Those who follow me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”
verses.13: So the Pharisees said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not true.”
verses.14: Jesus replied to them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true. I know where I come from and where I am going. But you do not know where I come from or where I am going.”
verses.15: You judge by the physical appearance; I, on the other hand, do not judge anything at all.
verses.16: And if I judge, then my judgment is indeed true. I am not alone; I am also with the father who sent me.
verses.17: And in that same law it is written that the testimony of two people is true.
verses.18: I am the one who testifies about myself, and my father also testifies about me.
verses.19: They said to him, “Who is your father?” Jesus replied, “Neither do you know me, nor my father. If you do know me, then you also know my father.”
verses.20: These words he spoke in the prison, while teaching in the temple. No one dared to oppose him, for that was the time when his hour would arrive.
verses.21: He said to them again: “I command you to come with me. But in your sins, you will die. Wherever I send you, you cannot go.”
verses.22: So said the Jews. But isn’t it true that he is saying that he can do whatever he wants? Wherever I send you, won’t you be able to go?
verses.23: And he said to them, “You belong from below; I belong from above. You come from this world; I do not come from this world.”
verses.24: I said to you that you will die in your sins. For if you do not believe that I am who I say I am, then you will indeed die in your sins.
verses.25: So he said to them, “Who are you?” Jesus replied to them, “What is the beginning of everything that I am about to tell you?”
verses.26: I have many things to say and judge about you. But he who sent me is indeed truthful. And what I hear from him, I tell to the world.
verses.27: They didn’t realize that he was speaking to their father.
verses.28: Jesus said, “When you raise up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He. I do nothing by myself; I speak only what my Father has taught me to say.”
verses.29: And he sent me along with him. He didn’t just send me away, because I always do what is pleasing to him.
verses.30: Many believed his words when he said these things.
verses.31: Jesus said to those who believed in Him, the Jews: “If you remain in my word, then you truly are my disciples.”
verses.32: And you shall know the truth, and the truth will free you.
verses.33: They replied to him, “Sperma Abraham is our father, and we have never served anyone else. How can you say that you are free people?”
verses.34: Jesus said to them, “Indeed, I tell you that everyone who does sin is a slave of sin.”
verses.35: But the slave does not stay in the house throughout the year; only the son stays there all year round.
verses.36: If then your son were to free you, then you would truly be free.
verses.37: I know that you are Abraham’s descendants. But please let me die, for my words do not find acceptance among you.
verses.38: What I have seen from my father, I will also do. And you, those who have heard from your father, do the same.
verses.39: They also replied to him, “Our father Abraham is here.” Jesus said to them, “If you are the children of Abraham, then do what Abraham did.”
verses.40: Now, they want to kill me, because I revealed the truth to you. This is something Abraham never did.
verses.41: “You should do the work of your father,” they said to him. “We were not born from prostitution; we have one Father, who is God.”
verses.42: Jesus said to them, “If the Lord, your God, is indeed your father, then love me. For I came from the Lord, and I will return to him as well. I did not come from myself; rather, he sent me.”
verses.43: Why don’t you understand my words? You’re unable to listen to what I say.
verses.44: You, from your father’s lineage, also desire to fulfill the desires of your father. That murderer was someone who existed from the beginning; in truth, he never truly existed at all. When he spoke lies, it was because he was lying, and his father was also a liar.
verses.45: But I say that I tell the truth; you don’t believe me.
verses.46: Who among you is responsible for checking my actions regarding sin? If I tell the truth, why don’t you believe me?
verses.47: He hears the words of God from God. Therefore, you do not hear that He is indeed from God.
verses.48: The Jews replied to him, saying, “Is it right for us to say that you are a Samaritan and also possess demonism?”
verses.49: Jesus replied, “I have no demons. I only honor my Father. You should also honor me.”
verses.50: But I do not seek my own glory. It is those who seek and judge who do so.
verses.51: I say to you, if anyone follows my words, he shall not consider death as something worthy of being endured during this life.
verses.52: The Jews said to him, “We now know that you are a demon. Abraham has died, and so have the prophets. And yet you say, ‘If anyone follows my words, he will not suffer death during this age.’”
verses.53: Do you not realize that Abraham, our father, also died? And the prophets also died. What will you do then?
verses.54: Jesus replied, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. My glory comes from my Father, who glorifies me. You say that he is our God.”
verses.55: And you did not recognize him; but I do know him. Even if I say that I do not know him, I am still a liar just like you. But I actually know him, and I also follow his words.
verses.56: Your father Abraham pleaded for me to see my day come true. And he did see it, and he was happy.
verses.57: So said the Jews to him: “Have you lived for fifty years already, Abraham?”
verses.58: Jesus said to them, “I truly tell you, before Abraham was born, I am.”
verses.59: So, he asked for stones to be placed on it. Jesus, however, hid himself and left the temple.
